text:
dylan: Heads-up: EU2 dedicated GPU pool (eu2-dedicated) is at 92% allocation and tail queue latency is spiking. Seeing sustained 200-350ms per-request queueing. Circuit breaker flagged for a subset of orgs. Investigating now. @jen @mike
jen: Thanks — what's the impacted traffic mix? low-priority vs prod?
mike: Looks like mostly low-priority cron jobs + some A/B experiment traffic. Prod routes still under 80% but trending up. Suggest we trigger weighted shift to hosted for low-priority first.
infra-bot: ALERT: CircuitBreaker activated on eu2-dedicated for orgs: [acct-412, acct-799]. reason=queue_latency>200ms for 5m. actions_available=[weighted_redirect, throttle, scale_up].
sam: I'm on it. Planning to run reroute command to move 60% of low-priority weight to hosted, and set a throttle for background jobs to 10r/s/org. Running:```shell
infractl route adjust --pool eu2-dedicated --selector priority=low --to hosted --weight 0.6
infractl throttle set --selector job=background --rate 10r/s
```
sam: Command output:```
> infractl route adjust ... OK
> infractl throttle set ... OK
> enacted change id=chg_2001234567-01
``` :white_check_mark:
jen: Nice. Can we warm the hosted pool first to avoid cold starts? last time cold spin added 800ms latency spikes.
maria: Starting warmup jobs for hosted-eu2: `warmupctl start --region eu2 --instances 6 --image hosted-runtime-v3` ETA ~45-75s. Also checking KV cache hit rates to ensure we don't regress.
odds: Please note cost estimate: shifting 60% low-priority -> hosted increases projected spend for next 24h by ~+$1.8k. If we need longer, recommend 40% shift + tighter throttles.
dylan: Warmers kicked off, ops-bot will report when done. I'll leave circuit breaker enabled for the impacted orgs until latency stabilizes <150ms for 10m.
ops-bot: Hosted warmup complete: hosted-eu2 warmed 6 instances, status=healthy, avg-init-latency=42ms.
mike: Monitoring dashboard: queue latency falling to 130-160ms after shift. Good sign. Keeping an eye on prod tail.
jen: Cost and product tradeoff agreed: keep hosted shift limited to low-priority, throttle experiments, re-evaluate in 2h. Also file a follow-up to increase reserved capacity for eu2 dedicated pool for QPS spikes. :memo:
dylan: Agreed. I'll flip the circuit breaker to relaxed mode once we hold below 150ms for 10m. Leaving this thread open for the next 2h for status updates.
sam: Post-incident actions (to-do): increase reserved GPUs by 10% for eu2, raise autoscale floor, add a runbook step to pre-warm hosted on predicted spike windows, metric alert tweak for queue latency to 180ms.
maria: Noted — I'll add KV-cache monitoring to the runbook and schedule a test warmup for next load test.
dylan: Thanks all. Closing active mitigation in ~30m unless we see regressions. :thumbsup:
